inconclusive_rule: all complete-evidence outcomes between positive and negative rules
negative_rule: no AGENT run is better than both MANUAL and its ordinal-matched PROGRAMMATIC run on both quality metrics, and AGENT has no meaningful search-efficiency advantage
positive_rule: median quality superiority versus MANUAL and PROGRAMMATIC by the practical margin, preregistered run-level repeatability, PROGRAMMATIC-relative search efficiency non-inferiority, and at least one structurally novel AGENT candidate
